g.title: note_enc
g.text: Customer keeps satisfaction, state, table and order private.
Its transitions (seatAt, placeOrder, startEating, pay, abandon)
are package-private and only called by Restaurant, so no
caller can skip a step of the dining flow.

g.title: note_poly
g.text: satisfactionAtPayment() are overridden by VIP and Critic;
GameController and Restaurant call them without type checks.

g.title: note_comp
g.text: Restaurant creates and owns its Tables, WaitingQueue,
Customers and HappyHour; they live and die with it.
ComboMeal is built from two existing MenuItems.

g.title: note_poly2
g.text: validate() and execute() differ per StaffTask subclass;
the controller treats every task alike (Command pattern).
